CanBeGeneratedInCombat.rationale: `=> false` (NotYet.cs:12) == the class attribute, with the sim's comment naming the same FilterForCombat consumers -- the correct treatment, unlike card/neows_fury (relies on rarity) and card/mind_rot (sets the wrong flag).

ctor.rationale: `base(2, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (NotYet.cs:18-21) == cost 2 / SKILL / RARE / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new HealVar(10m)` (NotYet.cs:14) == `_heal = 10`. `_heal` is in `Card._MAGIC_ATTRS` (cards/base.py:185-189) so `magic_number` surfaces it.

OnPlay.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Heal(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Heal.BaseValue)` (NotYet.cs:26) == `CreatureCmd.heal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._heal)`. BLAST RADIUS, not re-verdicted per rule 3: `CreatureCmd.heal` is the subject of creature_card_cmds gaps G4 (the sim refuses to heal a dead creature where C#'s Heal revives) and G5 (the sim reports the CLAMPED heal where C# reports the requested amount, and reports nothing at full HP). Not Yet is a ported live caller of that verb, so it is in both blast radii; the seam records them as dormant, and nothing about this card changes that -- the player is alive when playing it, and the only ported `on_hp_changed` listener (Red Skull) recomputes idempotently. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25).
